note: Gold answers: what a good tutor reply looks like for each question in tests.csv, in output-schema.json format. Checked by `node tools/dry-run.mjs fortnite`. Building answers must say building only works in Build matches (coach_notes).

reply.spoken: Jumping is on the X button, at the bottom of the four buttons on the right.

answers.question: how do i build a wall

reply.spoken: Building only works in normal Build matches, not Zero Build. Switch into building first, then place the wall.

steps.say: Press the circle button to switch into building.
Pull the right trigger to put a wall in front of you.

answers.question: My son keeps yelling 'box up!' what does that mean and how do I do it?

reply.spoken: Boxing up means building walls and a roof around yourself to hide. It only works in Build matches, not Zero Build.

steps.say: Press the circle button to switch into building.
Pull the right trigger for a wall, turning to build one each side.
Press L1 to put a roof over your head.

jargon.means: Quickly build walls (and a roof) all around yourself to hide from attacks

reply.spoken: A crank 90 is a fast way to climb high by building ramps and walls as you spin. It only works in Build matches.

steps.say: Press the circle button to switch into building.
Pull the right trigger to build a wall.
Pull the left trigger to build a ramp, then turn and repeat.

jargon.means: Build ramps and walls in a fast spinning pattern to climb high above other players

answers.question: how do I open the treasure box thing

reply.spoken: That glowing box is a chest. Walk up to it and hold the square button to open it.

steps.say: Stand next to the chest and hold the square button.

answers.question: I keep running out of bullets

reply.spoken: That happens to everyone! Reloading fills your gun back up.

steps.say: Tap the square button to reload.

answers.question: How do I see where I am?

reply.spoken: Open the map to see where you are and where the safe circle is.

steps.say: Press the big pad in the middle to open the map.

reply.spoken: GG means "good game". People say it at the end of a match, win or lose.

jargon.means: "Good game". Said at the end of a match, win or lose

answers.question: How do I do the floss dance?

reply.spoken: Dances live on the emote wheel. If you own the floss, you'll find it there.

steps.say: Press down on the arrows to open the emote wheel.

answers.question: How do I swap to my other gun

reply.spoken: You can flick through your weapons with the right bumper.

steps.say: Press R1 to switch to your next weapon.

answers.question: How do I drive a car?
